A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KDF/KDN research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, proofs, pseudocode, and experimental appendices are readable and matchable despite reorganization.

before.justification: v7 reports original simulations, experiments on 45 OpenML-CC18 datasets, semantic-shift experiments, and ResNet-based vision results.

after.justification: v8 retains original empirical studies and adds ViT-based results and confidence measurements on incorrectly classified ID examples.

M1.justification: The core Gaussian fitting, class weighting, and KDF/KDN inference procedures remain. Section 4.4 changes the documented ReLU activation indicator from non-negative input to positive output, changing its treatment of zero inputs. The consolidated parameter-estimation pseudocode otherwise follows the retained estimator equations.

E1.justification: The added ViT experiment explicitly introduces ImageNet pretraining into the reported training coverage. Evaluation coverage remains the six tabular simulations, 45 OpenML-CC18 datasets, shape-based semantic shifts, CIFAR-10 classification, and CIFAR-100, SVHN, and noise OOD tests.

E2.justification: The comparator families remain the parent model, Isotonic, and Sigmoid, with ACET, ODIN, and OE additionally used for vision. These columns remain in the retained ResNet comparison and are also used in the new ViT comparison.

E3.justification: Section 5 changes the stated fitting/calibration allocation from 90/10 to 70/30, without establishing that retained experiments were rerun. Section 5.2 adds ViT_B16 experiments with full fine-tuning. Evaluation also drops AUROC and FPR@95 and introduces MMC* on incorrectly classified ID examples.

E4.justification: Tables 1 and 4 add an error analysis measuring confidence on incorrectly classified ID examples for ViT and ResNet. The existing Euclidean-versus-geodesic comparisons, dimensionality study, posterior visualizations, and three semantic-shift scenarios are retained.

E5.justification: v8 removes the 45-simulation-repetition statement, the 25th–75th percentile definitions for shaded bands in Figures 1–2, and Figure 2's one-sided Wilcoxon test description and p-values. Bands and tabulated ± quantities remain, but their statistical interpretation is less documented. Fewer executed runs are not established.

E6.justification: New ViT results include KDN accuracy of 97.45% versus its parent's 98.06%, and CIFAR-100 OCE of 0.12 versus 0.47. These are new-setting results, not gains over v7's ResNet. The ResNet accuracy, MCE, and OCE values survive in Table 4, while its AUROC/FPR entries disappear. MMC* rows and a populated-polytope count are added. Figure 3D's displayed confidence profile also changes without an explained experimental revision.

T1.justification: v7's Appendix D assertion of O(mn²) time complexity is removed. The metric-space and asymptotic OOD convergence results and proof arguments remain. v8 explicitly specifies Euclidean distance for the asymptotic limit and clarifies cardinality notation; renumbering and removal of redundant standalone statements do not constitute new theory.

C1.justification: The central claims remain joint ID/OOD calibration through KDF/KDN, applicability to forests and ReLU networks, and avoiding OOD training examples while mostly preserving classification accuracy. Condensed contribution bullets and removal of the Desiderata subsection do not materially redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Section 5.2 newly interprets embedding-based KDN as improving inductive bias and scalability, and frames ViT results as a compromise when the parent already has good ID calibration. The Discussion adds an interpretation of geodesic distance as encoding learned low-dimensional structure and potentially aiding understanding of deep models.

D1.justification: Tables 2–3 newly specify b, Algorithm 1 revises the documented parameter/count estimation, and the ViT package, pretraining, and fine-tuning details are supplied. Conversely, Figure 1 loses the Trunk sample-size specification of 5000 and OOD radius of 20. Hardware/software information is relocated unchanged, and the future code-release promise remains.

R1.justification: v8 adds references for ViT, ImageNet, and CIFAR-10 and shortens the discussion of Meinke et al. The principal novelty positioning remains, and the supervised-contrastive-learning reference is retained after renumbering.

P1.justification: The introduction and contribution bullets are condensed, the Desiderata subsection is removed, Section 4 and its kernel subsections are renamed, and the Discussion is rewritten. Appendices are reordered and author information changes. Most of the exposition and main section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: A new ViT Table 1 accompanies the revised ResNet table relocated as Table 4. Main figures are resized or repositioned, Figure 2 loses p-value annotations, and Figure 3D is smoothed while its axis label is shortened. Captions and algorithm layouts are condensed. Figures 4–8 retain their underlying content.

improvement.justification: The ViT experiment helps assess KDN when the parent already has strong ID calibration, and the new misclassification-confidence analysis adds useful diagnostic evidence. However, v8 removes information needed to interpret uncertainty and reproduce parts of the simulations. The fitting/calibration split revision is also unexplained alongside identical retained results. These substantive benefits and transparency losses prevent a reliable overall quality judgment.
